items.titleZh: Skild AI 利用 NVIDIA 物理 AI 通过单个视频教授机器人新任务
items.titleEn: Skild AI Taps NVIDIA Physical AI to Teach Robots New Tasks From a Single Video
items.summaryZh: NVIDIA 博客报道了人工智能的行业发展。来源要点：制造车间、仓库和生产线很少保持固定状态——任务变化、布局变化和新产品到来，如果不进行重大重新编程，大多数机器人就无法跟上。
items.summaryEn: NVIDIA Blog reports an industry development in AI. Key point from the source: Manufacturing floors, warehouses and production lines rarely stay fixed — tasks change, layouts shift and new products arrive, and most robots can’t keep up without significant reprogramming.
items.overviewZh: NVIDIA 博客发布了有关“Skild AI 利用 NVIDIA 物理 AI 通过单个视频教机器人新任务”的最新更新。
items.overviewEn: NVIDIA Blog published a new update about “Skild AI Taps NVIDIA Physical AI to Teach Robots New Tasks From a Single Video”.
